newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cotton weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cotton weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA cotton export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net Upland sales of 95,000 running bales (RB) were one-half below the previous week and the 4-week average. Major increases for China (40,600 RB), Japan (27,600 RB), Indonesia (15,400 RB), and Mexico (10,300 RB) were partially offset by reductions for Brazil (9,100 RB) and Canada (8,600 RB).
Sales for the 1997/98 marketing year of 19,300 RB were for Japan (10,700 RB) and Canada (8,600 RB).

Exports of 101,200 RB--a marketing-year high--exceeded the week earlier by 45 percent and the 4-week average by 64 percent. Asian destinations accounted for 70 percent of the week's shipments; Western Hemisphere, 26 percent; East European, 3 percent; and West European, 1 percent.
